description: Get one iCloud contact in full by id (from apple_contacts_search): names, organization, job title, emails, phones, postal addresses and URLs — each with its label and an entryId that apple_contacts_update can target — birthday, note, the contact groups it belongs to, whether it has a photo, and when it was last modified. Requires ICLOUD_USERNAME + ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD (an app-specific password).

contactId.description: The contact id from apple_contacts_search or apple_contacts_create.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for lastModified (default: DISPLAY_TZ).

name: apple_contacts_get
title: Get an iCloud contact
